title: What clothes do you like to wear?

vocabulary.meaning_en: things you wear, like shirts and trousers
vocabulary.example: I bought new clothes for school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: nice to wear; not tight or hard
vocabulary.example: These shoes are very comfortable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: trousers made of strong blue cotton
vocabulary.example: He wears jeans on Saturday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: soft shoes for sport or everyday use
vocabulary.example: I run in my sneakers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clothing that covers each leg separately
vocabulary.note_ar: في أمريكا pants، وفي بريطانيا trousers
vocabulary.example: My pants are too long.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shirt that closes with buttons at the front
vocabulary.example: He wears a white button-up shirt to work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: warm and comfortable
vocabulary.example: My room is small but cozy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a warm top with a hood for your head
vocabulary.example: I wear a hoodie when it's cold.

vocabulary.meaning_en: soft shoes you wear at home
vocabulary.example: Put on your slippers in the house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relaxed, not formal
vocabulary.example: On Friday I wear casual clothes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: looking right for work
vocabulary.example: She looks very professional in her suit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a jacket and trousers of the same cloth
vocabulary.example: My father wears a suit to the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: serious and correct, for work or special events
vocabulary.example: We wear formal clothes to important meetings.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a warm knitted top with long sleeves
vocabulary.example: Wear a sweater. It's cold.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
vocabulary.example: I wear a scarf in winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short coat
vocabulary.example: Take your jacket with you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long warm piece of clothing you wear outside
vocabulary.example: My winter coat is black.

vocabulary.meaning_en: shoes that cover your foot and part of your leg
vocabulary.example: I wear boots when it rains.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft natural cloth
vocabulary.example: This shirt is made of cotton.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a way of dressing
vocabulary.example: I like your style.

vocabulary.meaning_en: strong and full of light (colors)
vocabulary.example: Children like bright colors.

fine_lines.title: comfortable vs cozy
fine_lines.explanation_ar: comfortable تعني مريح (ليس ضيقًا ولا مؤلمًا). cozy تعني دافئ ومريح معًا، وتُستخدم للملابس الدافئة والبيت.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Comfortable means nice to wear or use. Cozy means warm and comfortable.

examples.sentence: These sneakers are comfortable for walking.
My hoodie is so cozy in winter.

fine_lines.title: casual vs formal
fine_lines.explanation_ar: casual ملابس عادية للبيت والخروج، و formal ملابس رسمية للعمل والمناسبات.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Casual clothes are relaxed. Formal clothes are for work and special events.

examples.sentence: At home I wear casual clothes.
At the office I wear formal clothes.

fine_lines.title: wear vs put on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wear تعني يرتدي (الحالة)، و put on تعني يلبس (حركة لبس الشيء الآن).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Wear" is having clothes on you. "Put on" is the action of dressing.

examples.sentence: I wear a suit at work.
Put on your coat. We're leaving.

expressions.phrase: What clothes do you like to wear?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما الملابس التي تحب أن ترتديها؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about someone's clothes and style.
expressions.example: What clothes do you like to wear? I like jeans and t-shirts.

expressions.phrase: I like to wear easy, comfortable clothes.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحب أن أرتدي ملابس سهلة ومريحة.
expressions.example: I like to wear easy, comfortable clothes every day.

expressions.meaning_en: Say you have the same opinion.
expressions.example: I agree with you. Comfort is important.

expressions.meaning_en: Say the same is true for you.
expressions.example: I wear slippers at home. Same for me.

expressions.phrase: For work, I have to dress a bit nicer.
expressions.meaning_ar: للعمل، يجب أن ألبس بشكل أفضل قليلًا.
expressions.example: For work, I have to dress a bit nicer.

expressions.phrase: I need to look sharp and formal.
expressions.meaning_en: "Look sharp" means look neat and smart.
expressions.example: I have a meeting today, so I need to look sharp.
I wear boots in the rain. That makes sense.

expressions.phrase: They go with a lot of things.
expressions.example: Black shoes go with a lot of things.

expressions.phrase: There's no right or wrong way to dress.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا توجد طريقة صحيحة أو خاطئة للّبس.
expressions.meaning_en: Everyone can choose their own style.
expressions.example: Wear what you like. There's no right or wrong way to dress.

expressions.phrase: We should do this again sometime!
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن نكرر هذا في وقت ما!
expressions.meaning_en: Say you enjoyed something and want to do it again.
expressions.example: That was a nice talk. We should do this again sometime!

grammar.title: Present simple for habits: "I usually wear..."
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للعادات. ونضع كلمات التكرار مثل usually و always قبل الفعل: I usually wear jeans. ومع he/she نضيف s: She wears a suit.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present simple for habits. Put usually/always before the verb. With he/she add -s: she wears.
examples: I usually wear pants and button-up shirts.
At home, I wear cozy clothes.
He always wears a suit at the office.

grammar.title: Time and place: "When it's cold, I..." / "At home, I..."
grammar.explanation_ar: نبدأ الجملة بـ When أو بمكان لنقول متى أو أين نلبس شيئًا: When it's cold, I wear a sweater. At home, I wear slippers. لاحظ الفاصلة بعد الجزء الأول.
grammar.explanation_en: Start with "When..." or a place to say when or where. Use a comma after the first part.
examples: When it's cold, I add layers.
In the winter, I have coats and boots.
At work, I wear formal clothes.

grammar.title: like to + verb / love + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد like و love يمكن أن نستخدم to + الفعل أو الفعل مع ing: I like to wear... / I love wearing...
grammar.explanation_en: After like and love, use to + verb or verb-ing.
examples: I like to wear comfortable clothes.
What do you like to wear?

questions.question: What do you wear on your feet at home?
questions.explanation_ar: slippers هي الخُفّ الذي نلبسه في البيت.
questions.explanation_en: Slippers are soft shoes for home.

questions.question: At the office, I wear ___. I need to look formal.
questions.explanation_en: A suit is formal clothing for work.

questions.question: Which word is the opposite of "formal"?
questions.explanation_en: The opposite of formal is casual.

questions.question: When it's cold, I ___ a sweater.
questions.explanation_ar: مع I نستخدم wear بدون s.

questions.question: My brother always ___ jeans.
questions.explanation_ar: مع he/she/my brother نضيف s: wears.

questions.question: I love ___ sneakers.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد love يمكن استخدام الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: In American English "pants" are ___ in British English.
I wear boots in the rain. — That makes ___.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة: That makes sense = هذا منطقي.

questions.question: Navy, gray and black ___ a lot of things.
